name: f2-gdx-skill-latent-rep-graph
description: Renders the GDX_HNF_LATENT_* tables (written by F2_GDX_SKILL_LATENT_REPRESENTATIONS) as a standalone HTML page, one 2D latent-projection scatter card per method (PCA with loading arrows, autoencoder, UMAP), over the Firebird wire protocol (no native client library needed).
